limitations.note: The rewrite still registers the dispense outputs on the rising clock edge instead of decoding them combinationally from the current state and selection.
The rewrite replaced the original FSM with falling-edge credit accounting and queued change, altering simultaneous-coin handling and change dispensing that the correct fix leaves intact.
The testbench used the rewrite’s own balance-and-change model and checked outputs after rising edges, so it could pass without verifying that outputs respond to selection changes between edges.
The Git check failed because the workspace was not a repository, preventing the file read and forcing a second command.
